The lessons form one path. It starts with mechanics and numerical
simulation, continues with experiments driven by AI agents, and ends with
formal proofs in Lean. Within a strand the lessons are numbered, and every
lesson names the lessons it builds on and what it assumes you know from
elsewhere. Read the lessons in order, or start with any lesson whose
prerequisites you have.

This page is generated from the lessons when the site is built. A strand
appears once it has a lesson.
